rows: Decision: port the whole command: slot auto-creation with the next metro and android ports, the AVD (`avdmanager create ... --force` with `no` on stdin, deleted again on failure), the detached `emulator`, the two adb waits (online, then `sys.boot_completed` and `init.svc.bootanim`), the unlock keyevent and the claim. Failed tool calls are logged to stderr in the TS's `command failed` form. TS seam: `WF_ANDROID_POLL_MS` shrinks the 2 s poll (unset in production). Oracle: `android-start.integration.test.ts` (10 tests with `avdmanager`, `emulator` and `adb` stubs) plus the other Android suites, 25/25 on the TS bundle and the Rust binary unchanged. Not exercised: a real emulator or AVD. `android build|dev-client|expo-go` stay in the TS.
